items.content_html: ToothDINO adapts DINOv3 ViT-B/16 to panoramic dental radiographs with two annotation-free modules: DAVC for dental-aware global/local view construction and ABM for anatomy-biased masked-token sampling, improving transferable dental representations without changing the backbone or SSL losses.

items.content_html: Fursee is a three-stage pipeline for fursuit identity retrieval and clustering. It utilizes YOLO for detection, ArcFace-optimized DINOv3 for embeddings, and DBSCAN for unsupervised grouping. Outperforms GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Qwen on fursuit benchmarks.
